points.title: 法老
points.description: 图特摩斯三世早年继承王位，开始扩张埃及领土，巩固王朝统治。
points.descriptionEn: Thutmose III ascended the throne in his early years, began to expand the Egyptian territory, and consolidated the rule of the dynasty.

points.title: 法老
points.description: 图特摩斯三世在位期间，埃及帝国达到顶峰，成为当时世界上最强大的国家之一。
points.descriptionEn: During his reign, the Egyptian Empire reached its peak, becoming one of the most powerful countries in the world at that time.

points.title: 法老
points.description: 晚年，图特摩斯三世继续巩固埃及帝国的统治，确保其繁荣与稳定。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Thutmose III continued to consolidate the rule of the Egyptian Empire, ensuring its prosperity and stability.

appraisal.zh: 图特摩斯三世被普遍视为埃及新王国时期最杰出的统治者之一，其军事扩张使埃及帝国达到前所未有的繁荣，留下的文化遗产对后世影响深远。不过，也有研究者指出，他连年征战也给埃及带来了沉重负担。总体而言，其文治武功在埃及史上地位显赫。
appraisal.en: Thutmose III is generally regarded as one of the outstanding rulers of Egypt's New Kingdom, whose military expansion brought the empire unprecedented prosperity and whose cultural legacy had a profound impact on later generations. Some scholars, however, point out that his repeated campaigns also imposed a heavy burden on Egypt. On balance, his achievements in war and governance hold a prominent place in Egyptian history.

supporter.zh: 图特摩斯三世是埃及历史上最伟大的法老之一，他的统治使得埃及帝国达到了前所未有的繁荣。
supporter.en: Thutmose III is one of the greatest pharaohs in Egyptian history, whose rule led to unprecedented prosperity for the Egyptian Empire.

critic.zh: 一些学者认为，图特摩斯三世的征战给埃及带来了沉重的负担。
critic.en: Some scholars believe that Thutmose III's campaigns imposed a heavy burden on Egypt.

objective.zh: 图特摩斯三世是埃及新王国时期的杰出统治者，其军事扩张和文化遗产对后世产生了深远影响。
objective.en: Thutmose III was an outstanding ruler of the New Kingdom period in Egypt, whose military expansion and cultural heritage had a profound impact on later generations.
